content: Unsupervised Post-Processing. Further, we consider a variety of unsupervised post-processing steps that can be applied post-training on top of any pretrained input word embedding space without any external lexical semantic resource. So far, the usefulness of such methods has been verified only on the English language through benchmarks for lexical semantics and sentence-level tasks BIBREF113.
